US Judge Halts Taxpayer-Funded Ads Featuring Trump

A U.S. judge has ordered the Trump administration to cancel taxpayer-funded promotional TV advertisements. The judge ruled that the ads, which featured President Trump, must be taken off the air. The campaign was reportedly valued at $20 million.
